title: Soṇo
text: 1 Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2 Atha kho Soṇo gahapatiputto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Soṇo gahapatiputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti || ko pana hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti || || Yathā purimasuttantam evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ || || Ayaṃ kho Soṇa hetu ayam paccayo || yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti || ||
